=== FILE: verification_plan.json ===
{
  "format": "nirmaan.vplan",
  "version": 1,
  "requirements": [
    {"id": "TMR-PARAM", "section": "1. Parameters", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "The block works for every `W` from 4 to 32, and bits `W` and up of the `LOAD` and `COUNT` registers read as zero; a write to `LOAD` ignores them."},
    {"id": "TMR-RESET", "section": "4.1 Reset and registers", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "While `rst_n` is low at a rising edge of `clk`, `CTRL`, `LOAD`, `COUNT` and `STATUS` clear to zero."},
    {"id": "TMR-REG-RW", "section": "4.1 Reset and registers", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `CTRL` stores `wdata` bits 2 to 0 in it, and a write to `LOAD` stores `wdata` bits `W-1` to 0 in it."},
    {"id": "TMR-READ", "section": "4.1 Reset and registers", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A read never changes any register; `rdata` follows `addr` with no clock edge."},
    {"id": "TMR-START", "section": "4.2 Counting", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "At a rising edge where a write to `CTRL` sets `EN` and `EN` was 0, the count loads the `LOAD` value."},
    {"id": "TMR-COUNT", "section": "4.2 Counting", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "At a rising edge where `EN` is 1 and the count is not zero, and no write to `CTRL` takes place, the count falls by one."},
    {"id": "TMR-WRITE-WINS", "section": "4.2 Counting", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `CTRL` takes the place of that edge's count step: at that edge the count does not fall and the timer does not expire, whatever the count was."},
    {"id": "TMR-STOP", "section": "4.2 Counting", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `CTRL` that clears `EN` stops the timer and the count keeps its value."},
    {"id": "TMR-LOAD-LATE", "section": "4.2 Counting", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `LOAD` does not change the count: the new value is used at the next start or periodic reload."},
    {"id": "TMR-EXPIRE", "section": "4.3 Expiry", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "At a rising edge where `EN` is 1 and the count is zero, and no write to `CTRL` takes place, the timer expires: `EXPIRED` is set."},
    {"id": "TMR-PERIODIC", "section": "4.3 Expiry", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "In periodic mode an expiry also loads the count with the `LOAD` value, and `EN` stays 1."},
    {"id": "TMR-ONESHOT", "section": "4.3 Expiry", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "In one-shot mode an expiry also clears `EN`, and the count stays zero until the next start."},
    {"id": "TMR-W1C", "section": "4.4 The flag and the interrupt", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `STATUS` with bit 0 set clears `EXPIRED`, and with bit 0 clear changes nothing; it never sets the flag."},
    {"id": "TMR-SET-WINS", "section": "4.4 The flag and the interrupt", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A timer that expires at the same rising edge as a write that clears `EXPIRED` keeps `EXPIRED` set."},
    {"id": "TMR-IRQ", "section": "4.4 The flag and the interrupt", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "`irq` is high exactly when `EXPIRED` and `IE` are both 1, in one-shot and periodic mode alike; it follows the registers with no clock edge."}
  ],
  "items": [
    {"id": "T-SMOKE", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_smoke", "proves": ["TMR-RESET", "TMR-START", "TMR-COUNT", "TMR-EXPIRE"], "rationale": "Reset, write LOAD=5, start in one-shot with IE=0, and check that COUNT reads 5,4,...,0, that EXPIRED is set exactly one edge after COUNT reaches 0, and that irq stays low."},
    {"id": "T-PARAM-W", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_param_width", "proves": ["TMR-PARAM"], "rationale": "Build the bench at W=4, 16 and 32. Write LOAD with all 32 wdata bits set, then check that LOAD and COUNT (after a start) read with bits W and up zero, and that a full count-down from 2**W-1 to expiry works."},
    {"id": "A-PARAM-UPPER", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_load_count_upper_zero", "proves": ["TMR-PARAM"], "rationale": "Whenever addr is 1 or 2, rdata bits 31 down to W are zero."},
    {"id": "T-RESET", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_reset_mid_run", "proves": ["TMR-RESET"], "rationale": "Set every register to nonzero values with the timer running and EXPIRED set. Assert rst_n for one edge, then read all four registers as zero and check irq low. Repeat with a write asserted during reset."},
    {"id": "A-RESET", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_reset_clears", "proves": ["TMR-RESET"], "rationale": "!rst_n at a rising edge implies CTRL, LOAD, COUNT and STATUS are zero after that edge."},
    {"id": "T-REG-RW", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_reg_rw", "proves": ["TMR-REG-RW"], "rationale": "Write random and all-ones wdata to CTRL (with EN kept 0) and to LOAD, and read back wdata[2:0] and wdata[W-1:0]. Also check the untagged spec statements that CTRL and STATUS bits above their defined fields read zero, and that a write to COUNT changes nothing."},
    {"id": "A-REG-RW", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_write_stores", "proves": ["TMR-REG-RW"], "rationale": "A write to addr 0 implies next CTRL == wdata[2:0], except where expiry in the same edge is defined otherwise. A write to addr 1 implies next LOAD == wdata[W-1:0]."},
    {"id": "T-READ", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_read_comb", "proves": ["TMR-READ"], "rationale": "With we low, sweep addr within one clock period and check that rdata changes combinationally to each register's value. Repeated reads of STATUS while EXPIRED is set do not clear it."},
    {"id": "A-READ-COMB", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_rdata_mux", "proves": ["TMR-READ"], "rationale": "An immediate assertion: rdata equals the register that addr selects, at all times."},
    {"id": "A-READ-NOSIDE", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_no_write_no_reg_change", "proves": ["TMR-READ"], "rationale": "With we low and the timer stopped, no register changes across an edge, whatever addr is."},
    {"id": "T-START", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_start_loads", "proves": ["TMR-START"], "rationale": "Start from EN=0 with different LOAD values, including 0 and the maximum, and check COUNT==LOAD after the start edge. Writing EN=1 again while running must not reload."},
    {"id": "A-START", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_start_loads_count", "proves": ["TMR-START"], "rationale": "A write to CTRL with wdata[0]=1 while EN==0 implies next COUNT == LOAD."},
    {"id": "T-COUNT", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_count_down", "proves": ["TMR-COUNT"], "rationale": "Run with EN=1 and check COUNT decrements by exactly one per edge with no writes. Also run with interleaved LOAD and STATUS writes, which must not disturb the decrement."},
    {"id": "A-COUNT", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_count_decrements", "proves": ["TMR-COUNT"], "rationale": "EN==1, COUNT!=0 and no CTRL write imply next COUNT == COUNT-1."},
    {"id": "T-WRITE-WINS", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_ctrl_write_collision", "proves": ["TMR-WRITE-WINS"], "rationale": "Write CTRL (keeping EN=1) at an edge with COUNT nonzero and check COUNT holds. Write CTRL at an edge with COUNT==0 and check EXPIRED does not set at that edge."},
    {"id": "A-WRITE-WINS", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_ctrl_write_no_step", "proves": ["TMR-WRITE-WINS"], "rationale": "A CTRL write with EN staying 1 implies next COUNT == COUNT, and a CTRL write implies EXPIRED does not rise at that edge."},
    {"id": "T-STOP", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_stop_holds", "proves": ["TMR-STOP"], "rationale": "Stop mid-count and check that COUNT holds over many edges and that no expiry occurs. A restart reloads from LOAD, per TMR-START."},
    {"id": "A-STOP", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_stopped_count_holds", "proves": ["TMR-STOP"], "rationale": "EN==0 and no start write imply next COUNT == COUNT."},
    {"id": "T-LOAD-LATE", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_load_late", "proves": ["TMR-LOAD-LATE"], "rationale": "Write LOAD while running: COUNT keeps decrementing from its old value. Check that the next periodic reload uses the new LOAD, and so does the next start after a one-shot expiry."},
    {"id": "A-LOAD-LATE", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_load_write_count_unaffected", "proves": ["TMR-LOAD-LATE"], "rationale": "A LOAD write without CTRL write implies next COUNT equals the value the count rules give, independent of wdata."},
    {"id": "T-EXPIRE", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_expire", "proves": ["TMR-EXPIRE"], "rationale": "Check that EXPIRED sets exactly at the edge after COUNT reaches 0 with EN=1. Include LOAD=0, which expires on the first edge after start."},
    {"id": "A-EXPIRE", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_expire_sets_flag", "proves": ["TMR-EXPIRE"], "rationale": "EN==1, COUNT==0 and no CTRL write imply next EXPIRED == 1."},
    {"id": "A-EXPIRE-ONLY", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_flag_rises_only_on_expiry", "proves": ["TMR-EXPIRE", "TMR-W1C"], "rationale": "EXPIRED rises only at an edge where EN==1, COUNT==0 and no CTRL write occurs."},
    {"id": "T-PERIODIC", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_periodic", "proves": ["TMR-PERIODIC"], "rationale": "In MODE=1, run several periods. Check that COUNT reloads to LOAD at each expiry, that EN stays 1, and that the period is LOAD+1 edges."},
    {"id": "A-PERIODIC", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_periodic_reload", "proves": ["TMR-PERIODIC"], "rationale": "An expiry with MODE==1 implies next COUNT == LOAD and next EN == 1."},
    {"id": "T-ONESHOT", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_oneshot", "proves": ["TMR-ONESHOT"], "rationale": "In MODE=0, check that expiry clears EN (CTRL read shows EN=0), that COUNT stays 0 for many edges, and that a new start reloads."},
    {"id": "A-ONESHOT", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_oneshot_stops", "proves": ["TMR-ONESHOT"], "rationale": "An expiry with MODE==0 implies next EN == 0 and next COUNT == 0."},
    {"id": "T-W1C", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_status_w1c", "proves": ["TMR-W1C"], "rationale": "With EXPIRED set: a write of 0 keeps it set, and a write with bit 0 set clears it. With EXPIRED clear: a write of 1 does not set it. Upper wdata bits are random."},
    {"id": "A-W1C", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_status_w1c", "proves": ["TMR-W1C"], "rationale": "A STATUS write with wdata[0]=1 and no expiry implies next EXPIRED == 0. A STATUS write with wdata[0]=0 and no expiry implies EXPIRED is unchanged."},
    {"id": "T-SET-WINS", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_set_wins", "proves": ["TMR-SET-WINS"], "rationale": "Time a STATUS write of 1 to the exact expiry edge, in both one-shot and periodic mode, and check EXPIRED stays set."},
    {"id": "A-SET-WINS", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_set_beats_clear", "proves": ["TMR-SET-WINS"], "rationale": "An expiry implies next EXPIRED == 1, regardless of a concurrent STATUS write."},
    {"id": "T-IRQ", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_irq", "proves": ["TMR-IRQ"], "rationale": "Cover all four combinations of EXPIRED and IE, in one-shot and periodic mode. Toggle IE with EXPIRED set and check that irq follows after the register update with no extra edge, and that clearing EXPIRED drops irq."},
    {"id": "A-IRQ", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_irq_equals_flag_and_ie", "proves": ["TMR-IRQ"], "rationale": "An immediate assertion: irq == (EXPIRED && IE), at all times."}
  ]
}
=== END FILE ===

These include the 'other bits read as zero' statements for CTRL and STATUS, and COUNT being read-only to writes. TMR-PARAM needs the testbench built at several W values (4, 16, 32 at minimum). A reviewer should read each item against its requirement text, since the check reads only IDs. Once the RTL file name is known, add coverage points for mode x IE x expiry, the write-CTRL-at-count-zero collision, and the set-vs-clear collision on EXPIRED.; stripped undeclared citations: [req:...]
